baseline_environment.note: DeepGEMM's extension is ABI-locked to the PyTorch 2.7 stack, so the DeepGEMM arm runs in a second process on the same device in the same round.

campaign.deepgemm_scope: DeepGEMM's m-grouped kernels require group starts on a 256-row boundary and its k-grouped entry point takes the group sizes on the host, so only the three moe-* cases have a DeepGEMM baseline.
